newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech bank says 1996 deposits up slightly.
newsitem.headline: Czech bank says 1996 deposits up slightly.

text.p: Czech savings bank Ceska Sporitelna a.s. said in preliminary data on Wednesday that total primary deposits had risen to 294.7 billion crowns by the end of December, an increase of 127 million crowns from the end of 1995.

Foreign currency accounts of citizens and businesses showed "only minor changes in the order of tens of millions of crowns," ending 1996 at about seven billion crowns, the bank said in a statement. It did not say whether or not the change was a rise or drop and bank officials were not immediately reachable for further comment.
Final financial results for 1996 were not yet available.
